title: Lake Fairview Marina

services.name: Pontoon Boat Rentals
services.desc: Gather your group for an easy day on the water. Up to 8 guests, fuel included, 15 minutes from downtown Orlando. Birthdays, family reunions, anniversary trips, days when you just need to be out on the water. Lake Fairview is 405 spring-fed acres, 15 minutes from downtown Orlando. Rent a pontoon for up to 8 guests, fuel included, launch assistance included. The team here has been doing this since 2003 and they make it easy from the moment you arrive. Our standard pontoon boats are cleaned and inspected before every outing. Fuel is included in the rental price. No fuel surcharges, no surprises. Life jackets are provided. services.name: Sailboat Rentals
services.desc: Experience the quiet freedom of sailing at your own pace on spring-fed Lake Fairview. Choose from our three well-maintained sailboats, all priced for up to 4 hours. Just you, the wind, and 405 acres of beautiful Central Florida lake. The 23 ft Com-Pac is our most popular sailboat rental and the perfect choice for small groups. It accommodates up to four people. Spacious enough to bring a cooler and relax, nimble enough to really feel the wind. Enjoy up to 4 hours of quiet sailing on 405 acres of spring-fed Lake Fairview. services.name: Kayak & Paddleboard
services.desc: Experience the peaceful beauty of Lake Fairview at your own pace. Rent a kayak, canoe, stand-up paddleboard, or an AquaCat Paddle Boat and glide across the calm, spring-fed lake surrounded in the heart of Downtown Orlando. Our single kayaks are stable, easy to maneuver, and perfect for first-timers and experienced paddlers alike. Glide along tree-lined shores, discover hidden coves, and experience Lake Fairview at your own pace. Available for 2 hours, 4 hours, or a full day. Canoes are the classic Florida paddle experience. services.name: Sailing Lessons
services.desc: Most of our students have never sailed before. Finish the course and rent our fleet on your own. The ASA 101 course is 15 hours on a Com-Pac 23 keelboat. You'll rig and sail the boat, practice docking and knot tying, and leave with a certification recognized for bareboat chartering worldwide. Most of our students have never sailed before. That's fine. When you finish, you can rent our sailboats independently, on the same lake where you trained.
